sections.title: Iran fires at Bahrain again
sections.body: Bahrain's military said it intercepted Iranian drones aimed at a US base on 15 November, two days after US forces downed two others; the Guard said it targeted a radar at Riffa air base. A third US carrier, the Theodore Roosevelt, entered the region. Trump reportedly weighs holding off on strikes unless provoked, and told Vance to drop the Iran talks.

sections.title: Two chokepoints contested
sections.body: UKMTO said a tanker leaving the Gulf was hit by an unknown projectile on 16 November; the Guard claims more mine hits, unconfirmed. In Yemen, government forces withdrew from the Bab al-Mandab area to defend Aden, and the Houthis say they have retaken it; they are about 60 km from the city. The coalition said it intercepted two missiles aimed at Riyadh.

sections.title: Estonia answers Russia's sabotage
sections.body: Estonia detained eight people after an arson attempt at drone maker Threod Systems and named Russia's GRU; it says about 10 defence firms are targeted and plans to close three crossings on 1 December. An EU naval force boarded a false-flagged tanker, and Lithuania asked the US for a permanent base.

sections.title: The war reaches the Crimean Bridge
sections.body: Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge overnight into 16 November, forcing its closure, and struck Akhtubinsk airfield about 650 km from the front. Russia claimed 1,336 drones downed. Russian drones hit Odesa region; four people were killed across Ukraine on 15 November. The agreed prisoner exchange has not yet started.

sections.title: A three-way summit is set
sections.body: China's foreign ministry confirmed Xi will host Trump and Putin in Shenzhen on 19 November, naming world peace and strategic stability as topics; Washington wants nuclear cuts and the Iran war discussed. ASEAN and China again failed to agree a South China Sea code, and NATO dropped its 2027 leaders' summit.

sections.title: Israel's coalition fight sharpens
sections.body: Gadi Eisenkot said caretaker Prime Minister Netanyahu 'cannot remain' after a report that Netanyahu's chief of staff steered police toward a pre-election complaint against an Arab party, hours after unity talks. Netanyahu keeps authority over Iran and Lebanon operations while Eisenkot's mandate runs. Israel will charge a man with spying for Iran.

key_developments: Bahrain says it intercepted Iranian drones aimed at a US base on 15 November; a third US carrier enters the region.
China confirms Xi will host Trump and Putin in Shenzhen on 19 November.
Estonia blames Russia's GRU for arson at a drone maker and plans to close three crossings from 1 December.
Yemen's government forces leave the Bab al-Mandab area to defend Aden; the Houthis say they retook it.
Ukraine attacks the Crimean Bridge; an EU naval force boards a false-flagged tanker.
Trump pulls Vance off Iran talks; NATO drops its 2027 leaders' summit.
since_last_visit_brief: Bahrain confirmed it intercepted Iranian drones aimed at a US base, and China confirmed the 19 November Trump-Xi-Putin summit.
